correctness.rationale: The exact athermal symmetric-telegraph model admits a stable causal filter; its stationary spectrum is a strictly positive rational density with monic cubic denominator. Undercritical mechanical damping leaves one unique real noise pole, whereas overdamping factors all three rates into a uniquely determined positive multiset. All choices of which pole is the telegraph factor give and exhaust admissible aliases, even at repeated roots. A nonnegative Green kernel and positive-probability long runs prove the sharp essential support radius, and its algebraic inversion selects the correct pole. Generator moment equalities and 23,003 reproducible deterministic assertions corroborate, but do not replace, the proof.

value.rationale: The exact physical rate-alias classification of complete stationary position covariance is a natural identifiability question for a stochastic inertial active-matter model. A sharp three-system example shows the limit of every second-order position/velocity experiment, and a single physically natural stationary support boundary disambiguates all aliases. The theorem covers all positive parameters and collisions rather than an arbitrarily narrow numerical case. Practical finite-data estimation is explicitly outside the claim.
